scope: Phase 1: passive mechanical drone parts, robotics mechanical accessories and cleaning consumables only. No complete drones, and no electrical, electronic, powered or moving assemblies.

information.general: General product description. Specifications are confirmed against your model and part number.

fit.per-enquiry: Fit is confirmed for the specific model, generation and part number you provide. No universal or cross-generation fit is implied.

supply.on-request: Sourced and quoted on request. No stock, authorised-supplier status, price or lead time is implied until quoted.

products.name: Replacement Propellers
products.description: Replacement propeller blades for commercial and enterprise drones, sourced to match the exact model and generation you specify.
limits: Propellers are model- and generation-specific; no cross-generation fit is offered.
Propeller blades and passive hardware only; no electrical or powered parts.

products.name: Propeller Screws & Washers
products.description: Plain mechanical screws, washers and retaining hardware used to fit propellers.
send: Drone model or propeller part number
Thread size and length, if known
limits: Supplied as individual items or itemised packs only.

products.name: Airframe Screws & Standoffs
products.description: Screws, standoffs and spacers used to assemble airframe structures and covers.
send: Drone model or airframe part number
Size, thread and finish, if known
limits: Itemised quantities only; no unitemised assortment kits.

products.name: Structural Arm Sections
products.description: Bare structural arm tubes and arm shells for multirotor airframes.
limits: Bare structural parts only, with no electrical or powered parts fitted.

products.name: Folding Arm Hinges
products.description: Mechanical hinge and locking components for folding arm designs.
limits: Purely mechanical hinges; no integrated sensors or wiring.

products.name: Landing Gear & Skids
products.description: Fixed landing legs, skids and feet for commercial drone airframes.
send: Landing gear part number, if known
limits: Fixed, non-powered landing gear only.

products.name: Body Shells & Covers
products.description: Top shells, bottom covers and panels for drone bodies, supplied as bare mechanical parts.
limits: Shells are supplied without antennas, lights, boards or wiring.

products.name: Propeller Guards & Protective Cages
products.description: Propeller guards and protective cage parts for inspection and close-proximity work.
send: Guard or cage part number, if known
limits: Guards change flight characteristics; follow the manufacturer's guidance and applicable CASA rules when fitting them.

products.name: Passive Payload Brackets
products.description: Fixed mechanical brackets for mounting passive accessories to a drone airframe.
send: Accessory to be mounted and its weight
limits: Fixed, passive brackets only, with no electrical, data or moving parts.
Not rated as a load-bearing or safety-critical attachment.

products.name: Vibration-Damping Mounts
products.description: Rubber and elastomer dampers, damping balls and isolator plates.
limits: Passive mechanical damping parts only; no electrical parts.

products.name: Transport Cases
products.description: Empty hard and soft cases for transporting drones and accessories.
send: Drone model or required internal dimensions
limits: Cases are supplied empty; no contents are included.

products.name: Manual Maintenance Tools
products.description: Hand tools for routine maintenance, such as hex and screw drivers and propeller wrenches.
send: Drone model, if the tool is model-specific
limits: Hand tools only. No powered tools, chemicals or unitemised maintenance kits.

products.name: Brush Discs
products.description: Replacement brush discs and side brushes for commercial floor-cleaning robots.
limits: Brush discs only; no powered or drive assemblies.

products.name: Squeegee Blades
products.description: Replacement squeegee blades and rubber strips for scrubber robots.
limits: Blades and strips only; no squeegee lift actuators.

products.name: Filters
products.description: Replacement dust, debris and water filters for cleaning robots.
limits: Filter elements only.

products.name: Non-Powered Castor Wheels
products.description: Free-rolling castor wheels for cleaning and service robots.
send: Castor part number or wheel diameter
limits: Non-driven castors only; no powered or electrical parts.

products.name: Tyres & Treads
products.description: Replacement tyres, treads and wheel covers for warehouse robots.
limits: Tyres and treads only; no powered or electrical parts.

products.name: Wheel Hubs
products.description: Mechanical wheel hubs for non-driven wheel positions.
limits: For non-driven wheel positions only; no powered or electrical parts.

products.name: Passive Wheel Sets
products.description: Free-rolling mechanical wheel sets for support positions on warehouse robots.
limits: Passive, non-driven wheel sets only; no powered or electrical parts.

products.name: Gripper Fingers
products.description: Replacement and custom-profile fingers for mechanical grippers.
limits: Fingers only. Complete grippers, tool changers and safety components are not supplied.

products.name: Gripper Pads
products.description: Replacement contact pads and inserts for gripper fingers.
send: Pad part number, material or dimensions
limits: Pads and inserts only.

limits: Non-powered parts only; no quick-change interfaces, tool changers or safety components.
